purpose: Audit the first matured short-horizon observations that were immutably issued before their outcomes, without treating them as evidence for the separate 126/252-day joint-indicator candidates.

observation.sessionRule: XNYS weekdays strictly after the origin. The official 2026 NYSE holiday list has no closure between 2026-09-11 and 2026-10-12; Columbus Day is an open session.
observation.commonCohort: Outcome-independent intersection of symbols issued by all four models at the fixed origin/horizon and present in the fixed target archive. SPY is absent from v4/v5 and therefore is not in the common stock cohort.
observation.directionRule: Final numeric return above 2% is up, below -2% is down, otherwise flat. Always-up is direction-only. Classifier argmax and numeric sign are not forced to agree.
observation.weighting: One fixed issue date; every common-cohort security has equal weight.
observation.fullCohortRule: Do not publish aggregate v4/v5 501-security metrics if any originally issued security lacks the fixed target source. Preserve coverage and missing identities instead.
observation.probability: Only v5 raw horizonDirectionScores are audited with multiclass Brier and log loss. They remain research scores because this is one issue date, not sufficient calibration evidence.
observation.abstention: No row abstention in the complete common cohort. Missing full-cohort targets are coverage blockers, not abstentions and not removed from a claimed full-sample score.

hypotheses.A: A genuinely pre-outcome issued 21-session point forecast improves both price MAPE and return MAE over no change without materially losing direction performance versus the separately issued simple-trend control.
hypotheses.B: The horizon-specific v5 forecast adds useful downside detection or balanced direction accuracy while retaining the magnitude-error benefit of the earlier issued point forecasts.

decision: No selection or promotion from one issue date. Any blend designed after the target is observed is diagnostic only and is not evaluated here as an executable candidate.
longHorizonBoundary: 126- and 252-session issued forecasts remain pending. They are counted but receive no outcome score in this audit.
knownLimits: The 15-stock common cohort is a concentrated legacy watchlist and the evaluation protocol was written after the target date. Underlying forecasts were issued before outcomes, but this is not a preregistered representative trial. Current/revised target archives and lifecycle gaps remain.
